user.health_constraints: Mother has diabetes, need to be reachable within 2 hours of Ibadan

user_snapshot: Microbiology grad, one year post-NYSC, teaching lessons in Ibadan for ₦40k while anchored to a diabetic mother within a 2-hour radius. ₦200k saved, ₦25k monthly going home, high family pressure to show a real salary.
headline_insight: Ibadan sits 90 minutes from the Sagamu-Ota-Agbara pharma corridor — which means your Microbiology degree unlocks a real formal route most advisors miss because they only think Lagos. Your 2-hour mother constraint fits this corridor exactly.

routes.title: Pharma QA/QC Analyst — Sagamu/Ota Corridor
routes.one_liner: Move into a pharma lab role at Emzor, Fidson, or May & Baker within 4 months, earning ₦150-200k entry.

fit_reasons.note: Microbiology Second Class Upper maps directly to pharma QA hiring filters — no retraining needed.
Ibadan to Sagamu is 90 min — keeps you inside your 2-hour reach of your mother.

break_reasons.risk: Corridor rent and relocation costs eat ₦150-250k upfront, leaving you thin if your mother needs emergency funds in month one.

routes.who_this_fits: A science grad who wants a salaried formal role fast and accepts shift work in a regulated lab environment.
routes.who_this_breaks: Someone who needs Lagos social life, hates shift rotation, or cannot tolerate GMP paperwork discipline.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Your ₦40k teaching income for 3-4 weeks during transition, plus Ibadan proximity — you'll commute weekends home.

real_pay.range_note: Sagamu/Ota roles pay slightly below Lagos but housing is cheaper. Fidson and GSK pay top of band; smaller firms pay ₦130-150k entry.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you enter pharma QA by month 4, you're a QA Analyst II at Emzor or Fidson earning ₦280-320k/mo, with ₦1m+ saved and IELTS booked for the Canada Medical Lab Tech route.
pro_tips: Apply Tuesday mornings — HR reviews CVs before weekly production meetings.
Mention 'GMP' and 'microbial limit test' in your CV summary line.

Lead one stability study or deviation investigation

routes.nigerian_notes: Sagamu-Ota corridor housing is ₦150-400k/yr for a self-con. Most firms hire quarterly in batches. NAFDAC-registered firms pay better than unlisted ones.

routes.title: International School Science Teacher — Ibadan
routes.one_liner: Convert your existing tutoring into a salaried ₦200-400k role at an Ibadan international school within 6 months.

fit_reasons.note: Your existing Teaching skill plus maths/chemistry tutoring track record is already the hiring evidence these schools want.
Stays inside Ibadan — zero travel risk against your mother's 2-hour constraint.

break_reasons.risk: Top-tier Ibadan international schools are few (Lifeforte, Vivian Fowler's feeder, The International School UI) — if none hire, you're stuck at mid-tier ₦150k roles.

routes.who_this_fits: A teacher who enjoys classroom work and wants structured income plus long holidays without relocation.
routes.who_this_breaks: Someone who finds lesson prep draining or wants rapid income growth above ₦500k/mo.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings for 3 months building a teaching portfolio; possibly a PGDE enrolment at ₦200k if schools demand it.

real_pay.range_note: Ibadan rates trail Lagos by 20-30%. The International School UI and Lifeforte pay top band; Chrisland-tier mid; smaller private schools ₦80-150k.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, you're a Head of Science at a mid-tier Ibadan international school earning ₦350-400k/mo, with IGCSE/Cambridge training on your CV — which also unlocks UAE and UK teaching routes.
pro_tips: Get TRCN registration — unlocks the ₦250k+ band at serious schools.
Target hiring cycles: April-June and October-November.

routes.nigerian_notes: Ibadan international school salaries trail Lagos by 20-30% but so does rent. Cambridge (CIE/IGCSE) experience is the single biggest salary lever — chase it early.

routes.title: Canada Medical Lab Technologist Route (JAPA)
routes.one_liner: Use your Microbiology degree to qualify as a Medical Lab Technologist in Canada via CSMLS — work permit in 18-24 months.

fit_reasons.note: Microbiology Second Class Upper is eligible for CSMLS Prior Learning Assessment — the direct MLT pathway.
Your 'curious' JAPA appetite plus medium risk tolerance matches a 24-month prep arc, not an impulse MSc.

break_reasons.risk: Your mother's diabetes + high family pressure may make a 2-year relocation emotionally impossible even if you qualify.

routes.who_this_fits: A science grad willing to spend 18 months studying nights and saving aggressively for a regulated professional route abroad.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone whose family situation makes leaving Nigeria non-negotiable, or who cannot save ₦3m+ over 18 months.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦200-300k monthly savings for 18 months, most weekends to CSMLS prep, and eventual physical distance from your mother.

real_pay.range_note: CAD 55-80k/yr entry (₦4.5-6.5m/mo at ₦1150/CAD). Provinces like Saskatchewan and Manitoba hire faster than Ontario.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you pair pharma QA income with CSMLS prep, you've passed the PLA assessment, landed a Canadian employer LMIA or PR nomination, and earning CAD 55-65k as an MLT in a Prairie province.
pro_tips: Start with Saskatchewan SINP — fastest MLT provincial nomination.
CSMLS PLA costs CAD 1,290 — budget ₦1.5m just for assessment.

routes.nigerian_notes: Pair this route with pharma QA income (Route 1) — the QA job funds the JAPA prep. Running them together is the realistic play.

routes.title: Remote Data/Research Analyst — USD Contracts
routes.one_liner: Retool your Excel + research skills into SQL/Python and land $800-1500/mo remote data analyst work within 12 months.

fit_reasons.note: Your Excel + Research skills are the natural base for SQL/Python — a 6-month retool, not a full career restart.
Remote work keeps you in Ibadan permanently, zero conflict with your mother's 2-hour rule.

break_reasons.risk: Junior remote data market is saturated in 2026 — median time-to-first-offer is 12-18 months, longer than your ₦25k family obligation can absorb without the teaching income continuing.

routes.who_this_fits: A disciplined self-learner who can grind 2 hours daily for 9-12 months before seeing income.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone who needs visible progress monthly or cannot tolerate 100+ cold applications before a first offer.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: 2-3 hours every evening for 9-12 months, plus ₦100-150k on courses, laptop upgrade, and stable internet.

real_pay.range_note: $600-3500/mo (₦900k-5m at ₦1500/USD). Agencies like Turing pay mid-band; direct-client Upwork tops the range.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you survive the 12-month grind, you're earning $1200-2000/mo (₦1.8-3m) as a remote data analyst with 2 long-term clients on Contra, still based in Ibadan near your mother.
pro_tips: Skip bootcamps — DataCamp + Kaggle beats ₦500k cohorts for your budget.
Build 3 public dashboards on real Nigerian datasets before applying.
